name: causal-envelope-A
checkpoint: epoch60 only; no best-loss epoch search

envelope.envelope_normalization: applied+target; ignore physically inactive bands exactly as native metric

data.sv: RixVox-v2 canonical riksdagen_id; 32 train,6 validation,12 test speakers; 4/2/1 clips each
data.en: VCTK24 train x8,6 validation x2; LibriSpeech test-clean12 new corpus speakers x1
data.target: uninterrupted native Phase1 decoder; previous received full frame + loss1/2/4/6 + first recovery; native inverse and OLA120
data.test_audio: not staged before candidate admission; no feedback into training
data.augmentation: existing fixed snacka-plc-v1 path hash; bitrate12/24/32,10/20ms,harmonic0/1,clean/noise20/noise10,gain0/-12/-24; one per utterance
data.mask: SV bands13..15 excluded from band energy; MR-STFT cap8kHz
data.english_test_clip_rule: 25–50 transcript words, hash-ranked; metadata only before admission
data.metadata_inventory: 64 fixed RixVox offsets 3420000 + 1100*i, i=0..63; reduced from initial128 after API429 before training or quality measurements; LibriSpeech26 fixed offsets0..2500 step100 x5 rows

ranking_after_admission_only: sum EN+SV full-band log envelope ratios
envelope before control if exact tie
validation.reference: classical PLC; installed model is separately reported; fixed zero tolerances

acceptance.runtime: zero steady-state allocation, unchanged packets and uninterrupted PCM, inference <=3us, firstloss median<=25us

next_step: StepB requires a separate frozen deterministic trajectory/matched oracle protocol before measurement; no GRU in this study
